runs.summary:
Braze makes properties and franchises first-class data

Braze Account objects went generally available on 12 November. Brands can model the business behind their users, including properties, franchises and households, with hierarchies between them. Multi-property data modelling is the structural advantage hospitality CRM has relied on, and it is now native in a consumer marketing platform. The same release added Skills and External MCP servers, pushing the Braze agent layer toward an integration surface.

Attentive's new CEO Eric Miao set out an AI-first vision for the company on 9 November. Expect a roadmap shift.
